title: Review and close-out read done when no role-carrying ticks exist
description:
roleState (internal/statusmodel/build.go:748) answers PhaseStateDone for a role with no role-carrying ticks in the graph, so the epic-across-runs fixture — a run that failed at boot in waves and whose graph carries no review/closeout ticks — pins '✓ review ✓ close-out' in the golden's phase bar. The model suite pins the pending answer only for a graph that carries such ticks (build_test.go:327), leaving this direction unpinned. Worth a tick to either pin it deliberately or change the answer for a run that never reached the phase.
evidence: internal/statusmodel/build.go:748-771; internal/cli/testdata/watch_dashboard_epic_state.txt line 3

ticfac run epic-hn6 filed this backlog tick from the finding 0b556650d3c65d39a27b58794d514e05cf00f28f7afeb781b432e73b7ee830b7 (reported by run-epic-hn6/tick-qwb/attempt-14): the done is reachable with the finding standing, so it is a backlog tick with an owner rather than the epic's to absorb. The decision record is .ticfac/runs/epic-hn6/absorptions/0b556650d3c65d39a27b58794d514e05cf00f28f7afeb781b432e73b7ee830b7.json on the run branch.
